title: UserVoice Idea: 100% insecure - DO NOT TRUST
body:
WARNING: This site is 100% insecure and they do not review employers.  If you make the mistake of signing up here your personal data will be freely given to criminals and you will get slammed  with spam and phishing.

http://veterans.uservoice.com/forums/330333-vets-gov/suggestions/13602405-100-insecure-do-not-trust
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
The Veteran Employment Center (VEC) team verifies all employers who have access to Veteran profiles. It is unfortunate that anyone would try to take advantage of a Veteran. We have two blog posts to help warn Veterans about protecting themselves from phishing attacks:

Veterans: Protect yourself, your information from “phishing” attempts – blogs.va.gov/VAntage/26332/veterans-protect..

“Veterans Employment Center Website: False Claim of Breach” at blogs.va.gov/VAntage/23299/veterans-employm..

Please know that the Veterans Employment Center (VEC) does not send your information to anyone. The VEC puts the safety and security of Servicemembers, Veterans, and their families first by storing only general profile information, such as email addresses. The VEC does not store resumes, addresses, phone numbers, dates of separation, or any personally identifiable information (PII). VA reports all suspicious activity, suspected corporate fraud, or phishing activities immediately to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).

vets.gov team
